items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: I was playing uptown someplace with Clarence Gabriel and Burbank and Moran.

ctx.x: I'm trying to remember who you played with when I first met you.

Well it was, I think it was Albert Boybank. Must have been. Yeah it was, with Albert Boybank. That's right, yeah. That's right. And Moran, that's right. That's right. That's where Moran the trumpet player.
Yeah. What were you playing in, Moran and Burbank and who else?
